detail.longDescription: Paying for an app you could get for free? Ditchly lists free and open-source apps that do the same job as paid ones. Each one gets a score. We check it against public docs and price pages. 📋 Free swaps for 50 paid apps 🔁 59 switch guides, like Slack to Mattermost 📈 2026 SaaS price hikes, each from the company's own page Ads are marked. They never take the top spot. https:// ditchly.co # OpenSource # FOSS # SelfHosted # FreeSoftware
